about: The README's menu buttons and the site's link buttons, in order (3 per row in the README). tools/site/repo_art.py draws assets/nav/<id>.png from it, tools/site/badges.py writes the README block, tools/site/site.py renders the same links as buttons and tools/site/check_site.py checks that every one is on both pages. href is the README target; repo-relative paths become GitHub links on the site.
